bounded_changes.unmapped: Release-note changes to conversation UI, headless -p, /model, --model, settings, authentication, tools, permissions, usage, files, plugins, remote control, and other commands remain outside the selected catalogue mapping unless a hop says otherwise.
bounded_changes.model_picker_and_retry_notes: Notes that mention /model, --model, model-request retry, content-safety retry, the status-line retry countdown, or headless -p are discovery only. Treating them as outside agy models is an inference and does not qualify selected shipped behavior under Q-005 / Contract 029 Artifact Authority.
bounded_changes.selected_writer: 1.3.4 grows the source-model stack copy by 32 bytes. The 32-byte two-string element stride, the models map key, and the headless.Write argument block in func2 stay the same through 1.4.7. That writer observation is insufficient for qualification: it does not prove selected agy models dispatch, slug/display/default rendering, config/account/env/auth/model acquisition, errors/exit, or process/lifecycle/cleanup.
bounded_changes.missing_selected_static_proof: No retained Linux x64 or Mac ARM64 binary remains for a reachable agy models call graph covering dispatch, slug/display/default rendering, config/account/env/auth/model acquisition, errors/exit, and process/lifecycle/cleanup on both selected platforms. Metadata-only platform rows grant no behavior credit.
bounded_changes.minor_line: 1.4.0 opens a new minor line. Writer-stride identity does not qualify the hop; the catalogue claim stays at 1.3.1 as an identity-stop.
bounded_changes.docs_sample: The unversioned Antigravity headless docs show a padded two-column agy models sample. The 1.3.1 writer already stores a 32-byte two-string element, and that stride is unchanged through 1.4.7, so the sample is not a hop delta after the qualified ceiling. The decoder corpus stays the frozen 1.1.9 slug lines.
bounded_changes.deferred: No antigravity.headless claim, deferred headless interior point, ACP registry, exact hosted alias, or launcher is qualified here.
